name: rapunzel_tower_voxels_textured

scale.source: estimate: the jettied timber-framed upper room is the widest horizontal part. A first Hyper3D/paint preview voxelised at about 15x48x14; scaling the longest horizontal side to 20 m at 1 block/m targets ~64 blocks tall (55-75 requested) so the upper chamber, windows, roof cone and spire are not crushed. Not measured from a real building.

format_note: voxel 's' = shape (absent = full block): slab{size 0.5|0.1875,align} vslab{size,axis,align} stairs{facing,half,shape} wall{north..west: none|low|tall, up} fence{north..west: bool}; geometry = vanilla models (shape_fit.boxes01)
